newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM raises April, May rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM raises April, May rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said that it had raised margin requirements on its April and May rubber futures contracts, effective from Monday.
It raised its margin requirements on the April contract by 10,000 yen per trading lot, bringing the total April requirement to 106,000 yen, TOCOM said in a statement.
The margin for May was increased by 10,000 yen to 70,000 yen.
The increases were intended to cool overheated trade, TOCOM said.
The requirement on other rubber futures contracts was left unchanged at 60,000 yen.
